blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The joint congressional oversight committee (JCOC) tasked with assessing the implementation of the 2026 national budget has yet to convene. This situation goes on even as the House deliberations on the proposed P7.2 trillion national budget for 2027 has already begun. Under the General Appropriations Act of 2026 (GAA), the JCOC on public expenditures was formed to track the execution of the P6.79-trillion national budget for this year. The committee is composed of members of both chambers of Congress. READ: House, Senate to form joint oversight committee on public spending On the first day of the House deliberations […]...
